title: Stationary measures for log-gamma polymer on a strip and in half-space
summary: We study stationary measures of the log-gamma polymer on a finite diagonal strip and in a half-space. We establish the phase diagram for the stationary measure on the strip. To this end we develop a representation of {the Laplace transform of} this stationary measure by independent $\mathrm{Beta}_{II}$ random variables. We also present an analytic approach that extends Barraquand's contour integral representation of the Laplace transform.
